text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — I have three PRs that need coordinated merges: API #310 (v2 batcher), SDK #1284 (client updates), and helm chart #57 (runtime affinity). All depend on the API change. Can reviewers prioritize so we can do a canary tomorrow morning?
Samir Gupta: On it. Which merge order do we need? Is the SDK backward-compatible?
Maya Patel: SDK is calling the new `/v2/batcher` endpoint, so API should land first and be tagged. Console/backend helm changes are separate — helm can go after the API tag so image refs match.
Tyler Huang: I can review the API PR today. Will check autoscaling config and run the e2e suite. Any known flaky tests?
Jen O'Neill: Helm PR is tiny (label/template changes). Needs eng-runtime eyes — @Caitlin Ross do you have a sec later? :+1:
Caitlin Ross: I'll take a look this afternoon. Note: runtime uses a kernel selection flag, make sure the chart exposes `REDWOOD_RUNTIME_KERNEL` env var if needed. Example: `env:
  - name: REDWOOD_RUNTIME_KERNEL
    value: "triton"`
deploy-bot: Staging deploy queued for branch `api/v2-batcher` — build 2027. Status: queued.
Samir Gupta: SDK PR currently points to `branch/v2-batcher`. Ideally we tag `v2-batcher-rc1` after API merge so SDK can pin. I can keep branch pointers if tagging blocks us.
Maya Patel: Proposed plan: Tyler completes API review and we merge + tag `v2-batcher-rc1`. Then helm merges so runtime image/chart refs align. SDK merges last and we cut the client release. :rocket:
Jen O'Neill: Sounds good. I left a tiny formatting suggestion on the helm template (indentation) — not a blocker.
Tyler Huang: Started API review — one failing unit in `tests/batcher_test.py` related to sequence padding. Investigating, should be quick.
Samir Gupta: If you want me to rerun CI or tweak the client to match the new behavior, ping me. I can also run an e2e against the staging deploy once the API build completes.
Maya Patel: Can we aim to have API merged and tagged before 10:00am PST tomorrow? If that slips, fallback: merge helm with previous labels and put SDK behind a feature flag to avoid breaking production.
Caitlin Ross: Fine by me — I'll prioritize the helm/runtime sign-off today so we don't block the canary.
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone — I'll track merge status here and post the tag once created.
__notes: Single Slack thread string; messages are short and chronological. No title per agents.md.
